validation: 4x1 topology kept by design (1-GPU reservations are abundant on this cluster). Engine flags mirror the GPU-validated deepseek41 profile (TP8/PP1, job 61300901) reduced to TP4. Perf changes vs the ~5 tok/s baseline: max-num-seqs 2 -> 8 and --enable-prefix-caching (both batch/throughput levers that never touch the inter-node all2all path). The TP4 inter-node MoE all-to-all is the real bottleneck: ~5 tok/s = RDMA broken in the container (NCCL falls back to NET/Socket). The nccl_ep smoke hook (runs before weights) prints NCCL_DEBUG with the transport: grep 'NET/IB' vs 'NET/Socket' in the job .out. If Socket: RDMA needs fixing (container device policy, EACCES on uverbs0), or fall back to nodes=1/gpus_per_node=4 (same TP4, intra-node NVLink). Weights 166.9 GB fit at TP4 (41.7 GB/card); MLA KV ~2-4 GB/seq at 524288, pool throttles rather than OOM.
